## What's Changed
* feat: mutate ternary conditions by @espressolee in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/546
* fix: mutate methods of decorated classes by @Sanjays2402 in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/539
* Add mutation score badge support by @rxdt in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/549
* wip: don't mutate lines excluded from coverage by @nedbat in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/547
* chore: add support python3.15 by @even-even in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/551
* Fix mutants missed when tests clear os.environ by @DSeaStar in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/552
* chore: up mypy to 2.3.1 by @even-even in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/553
* Honour 'pragma: no mutate block' on else/except/finally arms by @dylanpulver in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/559
* refac: main decomposition by @nicklafleur in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/561
* ci: pre-commit workflow by @nicklafleur in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/567
* fix: delete twice "-24" param and up ruff for tests it by @even-even in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/565
* Fix "pragma: no mutate" on match/case headers being silently ignored by @mathieu-lacage in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/554
* misc: update history by @nicklafleur in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/576
* feat: process isolation and fork-safe test runners by @nicklafleur in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/566
* Fix obsolete test names never being removed from the stats file by @t-roi33 in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/569
* Release 3.8.0 by @nicklafleur in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/581

## New Contributors
* @espressolee made their first contribution in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/546
* @rxdt made their first contribution in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/549
* @nedbat made their first contribution in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/547
* @DSeaStar made their first contribution in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/552
* @dylanpulver made their first contribution in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/559
* @mathieu-lacage made their first contribution in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/554
* @t-roi33 made their first contribution in https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/pull/569

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/boxed/mutmut/compare/3.7.0...3.8.0
